comments.author: @railfan_neon_nfr
comments.text:
Can you make videos on Mexico City which also faces this same subsidence problem.. and also on how Netherlands manages to exist so beautifully while sitting below sea level? Jakarta could arrange the neighboring over ground water sources to be treated and supplied to the city ending dependence on ground water along with a good sea wall project like the Delta Works in Netherlands and the Marina Bay in Singapore that even acts like a giant rain water storage site for the city.. Plz do a video on Singapore's Marina Bay too 😁 

It seems their over-ground water resources are heavily polluted.. if they can manage to effectively treat that water and even recycle it multiple times, it would be a huge game changer for Jakarta! Singapore's Marina Bay is nice because the land just near it is still above it. In case of Jakarta, that land near the Bay has already gone below sea level.. Implementing the Marina model would mean having the northern parts of the city permanently under water.. Once they manage to end the ground-water extraction, they can think of a good sea wall project where the wall is same as the Delta Works and the sunken land behind the wall would be like Amsterdam... they would need to make it more aesthetic and not boring like the current setup where residents stare at a huge wall from their windows.
